# Contract: code-review

Third-party skill from [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) (MIT, Matt Pocock), skills-bundle snapshot 2026-11-13. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (Review a diff against repo standards and the originating spec). The method is upstream. Category: engineering. Kind: guidance-only (no scripts by design).

## Purpose
Review the diff since a fixed point on two axes: this repo's documented standards, and the originating spec.

## Use it for
- "review this branch"
- "review the diff since main"

## Not for
- API shape and breaking changes (api-design-review)
- writing the pull-request text (git-authoring)
- a threat model (security-threat-model)

## Accepted inputs
A repository and a fixed point (commit, branch, tag, or merge-base), plus the spec or issue the change came from if there is one.

## Deliverables
A side-by-side standards review and spec review.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Git

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local git. It does not post the review.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None.

## Workflow
1. Pin the fixed point
2. Identify the spec source
3. Identify the standards sources
4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel
5. Aggregate

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- The fixed point
- Which document is the spec

## Quality checks
- Findings cite the diff and the standard or spec they break

## Common failures
- A review with no fixed point
- Style nits presented as spec failures

## Limitations
- Guidance. Upstream asks for sub-agents; a single pass is still the same two axes. Not run here.

## Reproducible example
Not run in this import. Static checks only.
